statements.status_notes: The advisory affects the zstd-sys allocator shim compiled for wasm32. This image ships native Linux amd64 and arm64 uv and uvx executables, which do not compile or execute that WebAssembly allocator shim. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0410.html.

The advisory affects the zstd-sys allocator shim compiled for wasm32. This image ships native Linux amd64 and arm64 uv and uvx executables, which do not compile or execute that WebAssembly allocator shim. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0410.html.

RUSTSEC-2026-0410 is in the malloc/free shim zstd-sys supplies to the bundled zstd C library on WebAssembly. zstd-sys compiles that shim only for wasm32 (the module is gated on cfg(target_arch = "wasm32") and build.rs enables it only for wasm32-unknown-unknown and wasm32-wasi); Milvus is built for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, where the shim is not compiled and the C library uses the system allocator. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0410.html and https://docs.rs/crate/zstd-sys/2.0.9+zstd.1.5.5/source/src/lib.rs

zstd-sys 2.1.2 fixes this advisory.  The bundled copy ships inside the py-rattler build that the base environment installs through conda-rattler-solver. No published py-rattler build bundles a fixed version of this crate yet, so this finding stays under investigation until one does.

NiFi ships the prebuilt uv binary from astral-sh/uv release 0.13.5 at /home/nifi/.local/bin/uv. The finding is in uv's embedded Rust dependency tree; remediation requires a newer uv release that updates the affected crate versions. zstd-sys 2.1.2 fixes this advisory.
